## Survey open-0: LIN-4458 @ 0092d8d9e

**Ground moved.** `origin/main` is 21 commits past the grounding 4b5001ddf (pieces 3, 5, 6, 7). The code this piece touches is unchanged. The area doc changed: Waiting is unnumbered ("15, 16" were positions at 4b5001ddf: the `landingPrUrls` entry and `deriveCloseOutState`'s two PR lists). A new LIN-4453 entry also assigns this piece an **area-read kind** in the classifier, which the ask doesn't list. Lessons is about 5.2 KB of 6,144.

**Why it's hard: "first cited after the anchor" has two readings, and the literal one breaks row 13.** Row 13 (`lin-4438-blind-read-gate.test.js`): approve, a *not-ready* close-out citing PR1, a fix round re-citing PR1, a re-review. It expects wait, and the not-ready close-out is the anchor. If "first cited" means not cited anywhere before (the `seen` set that `auditAfterLandingCloseOut` uses), PR1 drops out, the landing is `[]`, and `closeOutWaitsOn` returns null when given an empty landing, so **the gate opens on a re-reviewed PR**. Row 14 can flip without that if only audit reports drop their re-cites (the notes-PR rule): in row 14 the audit is the only comment that re-cites PR1. Pin row 13 beside row 14 first. Only prose tells a merging close-out from a not-ready one.

**"Work after review" needs kind exclusions, or row 3 flips.** "Any later comment citing a PR the reviewed landing did not hold" also covers a blind read of an older PR (row 3 expects blind-read), a close-out citing a notes PR, and Survey and area reports. The classifier has to carry the exclusions as a written list.

**The consumer list is short.**
- `lib/recommendation-blind-read.js:59,64` (`blindReadStep`) reads both `assembleTrailFacts` and `landingPrUrls`. It isn't named.
- `lib/close-out-readiness.js:81-88` reads a status for *every* cited PR (`extractPrUrls` → `readPrStatuses`) to build the box. `readRunEvidence` (`run-evidence.js:253`) reads one PR only when exactly one URL is cited. That's two read paths to change, with no new reads.
- `routes/workspace-api-run-evidence.js:299-300` matches by **index**: `closeOutSetsDone({prStatuses, prIndex})` with `mergedPrIndex` from `recordMergedPrs`. `extractPrUrls` sorts newest-first and `landingPrUrls` oldest-first, so a shared index is wrong.

**Seam with piece 1.** This ticket blocks LIN-4460, and piece 1 rewrites `deriveCloseOutState` and both guard lanes, which are the same functions whose `prs` input this piece changes. `closeOutOnTrail` and `landingHasNotesPr` ship with no reader. Change only the box's input (`prs` ← landing, statuses by URL) and leave precedence to piece 1.

**Census scope.** Kind predicates sit in four files: `run-ledger.js`, `recommendation-facts.js` (six, including `planReviewVerdictOf`), `recommendation-look-first.js` (`isSurveyComment`) and `plan-review-round-trips.js` (`extractVerdict`). `openrouter.js` imports `isRuling` and `isPersonComment`. Agree with A14 whether verdict parsers count.

**What I'd do first:** ask A14. Then add two characterization tests. The first runs rows 3, 11, 13, 14 and 15 under the proposed rule. The second is a box case with a cited-but-not-landed PR and the `prIndex` Done path. Write both before `lib/run-trail.js` exists.

## Survey global: LIN-4458 @ 0092d8d9e

Main has moved past 4b5001ddf (LIN-4446, 4450, 4453 to 4457), but none of those commits touched the files this ticket names. Its line references still hold.

**Where it lands.** The comment-reading layer is split across two files. `lib/run-ledger.js` (728 lines) holds the ledger, four comment openings, PR URLs, `landingPrUrls`, the blind-read check and `readGateTrail`. `lib/recommendation-facts.js` holds `isAgentNote`, `isRuling`, `isPersonComment` and the private `isLandingEvidence`, `isAuditReport` and `planReviewVerdictOf`. It is getting better: LIN-4437 to 4439 gathered the openings, the sort and `prOf`, and LIN-4455's `FEEDBACK_KINDS` table plus census is the pattern to copy. But the area's Waiting list is now 18 entries, and five of them are about this one question: which comments count, and which PRs are "this task's".

**Done the obvious way.** The trap is the box. The ticket names `buildRunEvidence`'s one PR read. It fires only when `extractPrUrls` yields exactly one PR (`lib/run-evidence.js:253`). But `deriveCloseOutState`'s `prs`/`prStatuses` also come from `readCloseOutChain` (`lib/close-out-readiness.js:81`), which reads every cited PR's status. That chain feeds the stop-at guard, the owner's check (`routes/workspace-api-run-evidence.js:272`, `prIndex` into `closeOutSetsDone`) and `lib/close-out-merges.js:143`, which decides what gets merged. Change only the page side and the box counts the landing while the guard and the merge count every citation. That is the five-lane split the LIN-4438 Lesson warns about, and the shared-trail table wouldn't catch it. So "the box's PR list as a decider" has to retire inside `deriveCloseOutState` (or `readCloseOutChain`), not in one caller. `prStatuses` is index-aligned with `prs`, so the URL matching belongs there too.

Also:
- **Census reach.** `isBlindRead` is used as a kind check in `routes/proxy-writes.js:717`, and `isSurveyReport` in `lib/recommendation-look-first.js:94`. `extractVerdict` (`lib/plan-review-round-trips.js`) reads plan-review verdicts a second way beside `planReviewVerdictOf`. Re-exporting from `run-ledger.js` would leave two homes. Define the census's word list before writing it.
- **Headings without owners.** The audit heading is a literal in `prompt-template-defs.js:1147`, read back by regex in `isAuditReport`. Survey and blind read have constants in `lib/prompts/*-words.js`; the audit and agent-note openings don't. That's A14's side.
- **The area-read Waiting entry names LIN-4458**, but the ask doesn't include an area-read kind. Either add it (one row, cheap) or rewrite that entry so it stops pointing here.
- Lessons: 5,206 of 6,144 bytes. Room for one clause.

**Better, at this task's cost.** `commentKindOf` as a frozen table (kind, opening, carries-landing, counts-as-work), like `FEEDBACK_KINDS`, with the census keyed on it. Move the openings out of `run-ledger.js` rather than re-exporting them. Have `readCloseOutChain` and `buildRunEvidence` take their PR list from `readTrail().landing`, so the box, the guard and the merge share one decider.

**Not this task's.** The deeper cause is that comments carry no kind. Readers guess from first lines, and row 15 stays unfixable because no caller knows the repository. A kind stamped at post time (the proxy already inspects bodies in `refusedByBlindRead`) and a task-repository fact would remove the guessing. The box/guard precedence split and `closeOutSetsDone` skipping the gate (both in Waiting) aren't this task's either.

- **The conflict** was in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` Waiting.

  - Also kept: this piece's removal of the three settled entries and its rewritten row-15 entry.

## Review — LIN-4458

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2435 at head `3081a1bc74077e4426369eb60059ba2da9773642` (5 commits on main `5cf4f6aa2`, `MERGEABLE`/`CLEAN`).

CI: green on `3081a1bc7`: Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success (run 43474446034). I also re-ran the four LIN-4458/4438 suites and `run-closeout-state` locally: 195/195 pass.

### Scope against the plan
- **Classifier home.** It is Runs, by A14's recorded agreement (LIN-4448 08c9c898, corrected by 097a3442; renewed with the census boundary in 1a2e7cba). The fallback was not needed.
- **Departures.** Each is recorded on LIN-4447 (comments 44101230 and 4e4c23c6) with its reason:
  - the URL-keyed `Map` moves here from piece 1;
  - Done is loosened for an abandoned PR outside the landing, as plan-review note 3 (12619798) allows when the change is named and has its own witness;
  - the guard is stricter on `head-moved`;
  - the `area-read` kind is added (the LIN-4453 Waiting entry assigned it here, and the parent asks for Waiting entries to be settled).
- **What changed on disk matches what was recorded.** That covers 37 files, the area notes and the PR body. The ticket's size record ("the guard, the owner's check and the merge read the same landing") covers the extra decision paths.
- **Area note.** The three settled Waiting entries are removed, row 15 is rewritten as a stated limit, LIN-4459's two entries are kept, and Lessons are ≈5.86 KB (under 6,144). The new Lesson clause matches the code.
- **Leftovers.** There is no `### Leftovers` comment on the trail. Its substance is in the PR body and comment a9b2fef6: each Waiting entry named there as settled is removed in this diff (checked).
- **Staleness.** None of the named files changed on main after the ticket was filed, apart from this PR's own rebase.

### Regression check
`git log -12` over every modified lib/route file. These earlier fixes are still intact:
- LIN-3248 F2 (Done once per merge): the route now passes `state.pr.url`, which is `candidateMerged` when the status is `merged`;
- LIN-3418/3634/3657 (`head-moved`): now stricter, and pinned;
- LIN-4396's `isSurveyReport` through `opensWithHeading`: the Survey rows use the same exact-heading match;
- LIN-3863 (merge recorded on a person's Done): intact, except in the empty-landing case below.

Nothing reverted is re-applied.

### Mutation checks (each reverted afterwards)
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| agent-note `work` → `never` | red: "agent note … cites a new PR is work after review" |
| agent-note `work` → `cites-pr` | red: "re-cites the reviewed PR is not work after review" |
| audit `landing` → `all` | red: row 14 in four places (trail, gate, write check, prompt) |
| `readCloseOutChain` reads `extractPrUrls` again | red: guard, merge recorder, both Done witnesses, gate rows 1 and 10 |
| box keys the status by `urls[0]` instead of the landing PR | red: "landing of [A] cited beside B reads A in the box" |
| `readRunEvidence` reads only when exactly one PR is cited | red: the same test, plus "PR cited only by a Survey" |
| route Done with `prUrl: null` | red: "landing [A] sets Done … B closed outside" |
| blind-read write check uses every cited PR | red: row 14 and the area-read write check |
| census: an opening regex added to `recommendation-facts.js` | red |
| **census: `String(b).startsWith("## Blind read")` added to `routes/dashboard.js`** | **stays green** (see ledger item 2) |

### Independent recount (partial)
I ran `landingPrUrls` from main and from the branch over 22 live trails (LIN-4396, 4401, 4414, 4432, 4437–4446, 4450, 4451, 4453–4457, 4459). Every landing is identical. That agrees with the PR's "no landing's read status changed". I did not re-run the builder's measure-1 driver, which is not committed.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is "who decides which comments and PRs are the task's".
- **Inside instances: all handled.** The census and `git grep` find no retired kind predicate outside `lib/run-trail.js`. Every caller of `deriveCloseOutState`, `closeOutSetsDone`, `recordMergedPrs` and `readCloseOutChain` passes the `Map`/`prUrl`. The four named consumers, plus `blindReadStep`, which the ask did not name, read the trail pass.
- **One sibling, outside:** `lib/ci-wake-sweep.js:53` `FULL_PR_URL_RE` (see Outside finds).

### What CI Did Not Prove
1. **Inside: the box, the person's Done and the merge recorder when the landing is empty but PRs are cited.** This is not pinned and not named. Precondition: a not-ready `## Close-out` citing A sits before the latest review, and the re-review names the PR only as `#41` (the review prompt asks for the head, not the URL). Probe, same trail and status:
   - main: box `merged`, and the person's check can set Done;
   - branch: landing `[]`, box `no-pr`, the person's check sets no Done, and the recorder records nothing (LIN-3863).

   This fails closed for Done and follows from the asked rule ("the box counts the landing"). But the PR body's "every surface answers exactly as before wherever the cited PRs and the landing match" does not cover it. None of the 22 live trails has this shape.
   **Before the merge**, close-out:
   - adds a test to `tests/unit/lin-4458-landing-consumers.test.js` on that trail (impl cites A; review Approve cites A; `## Close-out` citing A, not ready; re-review Approve citing `#41` only), asserting `readTrail().landing` is `[]` and `buildRunEvidence(...).closeOut.status === 'no-pr'` given a merged status, with the old answer (`merged`) in the test name;
   - adds the row to the PR body's behaviour table.

   The cause, the anchor rule and the gate, predates this ticket; it is the first Outside find below.
2. **Inside: the classifier census catches regex literals, retired names and the ruling-mark string, but not a kind check written with a string method.** `x.startsWith('## Blind read')`, `x.includes(BLIND_READ_HEADING)` and `x.startsWith(SURVEY_HEADINGS[...])` all pass it. It is the ticket's own witness ("no comment-kind predicate outside `lib/run-trail.js`").
   **Before the merge**, close-out extends `findings()` in `tests/unit/lin-4458-comment-kind-census.test.js`:
   - flag a `CallExpression` whose callee property is one of `startsWith`, `includes`, `indexOf`, `match`, `test` or `endsWith`, when an argument is either:
     - the identifier `BLIND_READ_HEADING`, or a member expression on `SURVEY_HEADINGS`;
     - a string literal matching `/^#{1,6}\s/` that also matches `OPENING`;
   - add self-test cases for those three shapes to "the census would catch the old copies".

   I prototyped exactly this: it finds 0 hits in today's tree and catches all three shapes.
3. **Inside: the URL-keyed reads against real GitHub on the live box.** CI drives the reads through seams; the reader itself (`readPrStatusFailOpen`) is unchanged, and only the URL list is narrower.
   **After the deploy:**
   - open the task page for LIN-4454 (single-PR landing #2425): the box should read merged;
   - open LIN-4439 (landing [#2413, #2415]): a multi-PR landing reads no status, so the box shows not known merged;
   - on the next stop-at-PR check, `[close-out-readiness] PR unreadable, admitting` must not appear for a readable PR.
4. **Inside, discharged: no caller still passes an array of statuses or a `prIndex`.** I grepped every caller (listed above). An array throws `TypeError`, so LIN-4460's rebase fails loudly in its own CI if it misses one.
5. **Inside, discharged (partially): the recount.** My 22-trail landing comparison above. The builder's window figures (19 landings, 10 read) stand as the builder's.

### Outside finds (close-out writes them; each is a Waiting entry in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`, since both files map there)
- **The empty-landing root.** Entry, ready to write:
  > `lib/run-trail.js` `readTrail`: a re-review after a not-ready close-out that names the PR only as `#N` leaves the landing empty. `closeOutWaitsOn` (`lib/run-closeout-state.js`) then opens the gate with no blind read, and since LIN-4458 the box reads `no-pr`, the person's check sets no Done and the merge recorder records nothing. The review prompt asks for the head, not the PR URL. Fix: fall back to the anchor close-out's PRs when nothing after the anchor cites one, or have the review prompt require the full URL (A14's side). (LIN-4458 review.)

  It does not break behaviour today (no live trail has the shape), so it does not need a ticket.
- **A second full-PR-URL reader.** Entry, ready to write:
  > `lib/ci-wake-sweep.js` `prRefsFromPark` parses a runner's park message with its own `FULL_PR_URL_RE` (scheme optional, repo key case-folded) beside `prUrlsIn`/`prOf` (`lib/run-ledger.js`). Its comment-side read already goes through `extractPrUrls`. Moving it onto `prUrlsIn` changes which park messages wake (a scheme-less URL would stop matching), so it needs its own witness. (LIN-4458 review.)

  This is outside because its input is the park text, not the comment trail that this ticket's "parse full PR URLs only through `prOf`/`prUrlsIn`" governs.

### Verdict
How the work meets each sentence of the `## As asked` block:
- **Ask A14 again; one classifier either way.** Asked and agreed (08c9c898, 1a2e7cba). There is one classifier, `COMMENT_KINDS`/`commentKindOf`.
- **`lib/run-trail.js` holds `commentKindOf` and `readTrail`; `readGateTrail` and `assembleTrailFacts` consume them.** Met; both are views of `readTrail`.
- **Landing = the PRs first cited after the anchor; row 14 flips.** Met. The reading is first appearance after the anchor (row 13 pinned, and the call is recorded in 44101230). Row 14 is flipped in the gate, the write check and the prompt.
- **Work after review = a later comment citing a PR the reviewed landing did not hold, agent notes included; counts today's non-agent landing evidence; re-citing the reviewed PR does not restart review.** Met. The agent note uses `cites-new-pr`, plain and plan-review comments keep today's `cites-pr`, and the exclusion list is written in the table. Both witnesses go red under mutation.
- **Parse full PR URLs only through `prOf`/`prUrlsIn`.** Met on the trail. `ci-wake-sweep`'s park-text parser is an Outside find.
- **The box counts the landing; one read of the sole landing PR, matched by URL; a multi-PR landing reads none.** Met and mutation-checked. The empty-landing consequence is ledger item 1.
- **`resolveRunPrRef` keeps choosing from the cited URLs.** Met; the picker withholding is pinned.
- **`extractPrUrls` only records citations; `landingPrUrls` is a thin export.** Met.
- **`readTrail` returns the six fields piece 1 reads.** Met; pinned in "readTrail returns the fields piece 1 reads".
- **Update the four consumers.** Met, and `blindReadStep` as well.
- **Retires the listed items; settles Waiting 16 and 15, with 15 rewritten as a limit.** Met. It retires a little more than listed (the index coupling, the ruling mark's second spelling, the plan-comment home), and all of it is named in the PR.
- **Witnesses: the agent note's new and re-cited PR, row 14, the census, [A] beside B, the write-check and prompt tests, the recount, the reconciliation grep.** All present. The census is weaker than its claim (ledger item 2), and I re-checked the recount in part.
- **Binding rules.** Met:
  - readiness is computed on read, never stored;
  - no new GitHub or provider reads (they are narrower);
  - Waiting entries and Lessons are updated in the same change;
  - the PR names what it retires;
  - no recorded changelog text is edited;
  - A14's side is untouched apart from import paths.

Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

Autopilot note: engine override on the next step.

After the review (comment 50135ba2, verdict line "Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger"), the recommender chose another review, reading the verdict as unknown with three undischarged items. I pinned the verb to close-out instead (dispatch cffce052-9932-43f4-89b7-129192f68f27, override recorded): a conditional Approve is exactly what close-out discharges, and re-reviewing would not settle the ledger.

Close-out should: pin the empty-landing case with a test and add its row to the PR body behaviour table (ledger 1); extend the census to string-method checks (ledger 2); write the two Outside finds as Waiting entries; merge on green on the exact head; do the post-deploy checks (ledger 3) once the deploy lands; then set Done. I will verify each myself on the PR and the issue.

Held, not merged: LIN-4458 has no `## Blind read` since the review, so its work is not ready to finish. Next action: `blind-read`.

What I checked (just now):
- The trail ends: Review (50135ba2, "Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger") then the Autopilot note (c674a076). No `## Blind read` comment follows either one.
- The PR to merge is #2435 (JKershaw/LinearViewer), head `3081a1bc74077e4426369eb60059ba2da9773642`, still OPEN, MERGEABLE/CLEAN. Nothing has changed since the review.

What I did not do, and why:
- I made none of the review's fixes (empty-landing test and PR-table row, stronger census `findings()`, the two Waiting entries). Each would change the head, and the blind read should read the head that will merge. A blind read's fix-sized finds are also fixed in the same close-out pass, so one pass after it is cheaper than two.
- I did not merge and did not set Done.

The Autopilot note pinned the verb to close-out and does not mention the blind-read requirement. A conditional Approve gives me authority to finish, but not to skip the blind read the close-out rules require before a merge. Re-dispatching close-out once a `## Blind read` naming #2435 is on the trail picks the work up from the ledger as written in the review.

## Blind read
Verdict: better. It gives comment kinds one owner, a single `COMMENT_KINDS` table in `lib/run-trail.js` with a census test. That replaces the classifiers spread over `lib/run-ledger.js`, `lib/recommendation-facts.js` and `lib/recommendation-look-first.js`. It also replaces index-aligned PR statuses with a URL-keyed Map (`lib/run-closeout-state.js`, `lib/close-out-readiness.js`). Against that, `lib/run-evidence.js` now holds two PR lists (cited and landing) and reads the trail twice, matching a bare `prStatus` to the landing by convention, and two how-to docs still describe the old layout.

Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2435 at `3081a1bc7` against `5cf4f6aa2`.

### Inside the area, fix-sized
- `lib/run-evidence.js` (runs-and-dispatch): `readRunEvidence` calls `landingPrUrls(comments)` to choose the one PR to read, then passes a bare `prStatus` to `buildRunEvidence`. That function runs the trail again (`readGateTrail` / `landingPrUrls`) and assumes the status belongs to the landing's sole PR. So there are two trail passes and an unstated pairing, the same coupling by position that this change removed from `deriveCloseOutState`. Fix: pass `buildRunEvidence` the status keyed by URL (a one-entry Map, or `{url, status}`) and the landing already read, so it neither reads the trail again nor guesses which PR the status belongs to.
- `docs/architecture/source-map.md` (runs-and-dispatch, via `lib/close-out-readiness.js`): the `close-out-readiness.js` row still says `comments → PR urls → every PR status → ledger`, and lists `readGateTrail` as defined there. That function is in `lib/run-trail.js`, and the chain now reads only the landing's PRs. The `blind-read-words.js` and `survey-words.js` rows say `lib/run-ledger.js` parses or reads them; `lib/run-trail.js` does now, and no row names `run-trail.js`. Fix: correct those three rows and add one for `lib/run-trail.js`.
- `docs/prompt-pipeline/stage-descriptions/review-closeout.md` (runs-and-dispatch, via `lib/run-trail.js`): the table of machine-read strings still names `isReviewSummary` in `lib/run-ledger.js` (the review-title and verdict-word rows), and the `### Plan Review Verdict` row cites `lib/run-ledger.js:39`. Neither exists at HEAD: the rules are the `review` and `plan-review` rows of `COMMENT_KINDS` in `lib/run-trail.js`. Fix: point those rows at `lib/run-trail.js`. Their line numbers were already wrong at the base commit, so drop them.

### Inside the area, larger
- `lib/run-evidence.js` (runs-and-dispatch): `lib/run-trail.js` says the box, the guard, the route and the prompt "cannot disagree about which PRs are the task's", but the run page still keeps a second list. `deriveState` over `extractPrUrls` (every cited PR) still drives `done`, `checked.now` and `resolveRunPrRef`, which the `routes/dashboard.js` pr-state route reads. The close-out box beside it counts `readTrail().landing`. `lib/ci-wake-sweep.js` also still matches parks against every cited PR. That leaves two answers to "which PR is the task's" on one page. This is larger than a fix: whether the page's PR and the CI-wake sweep should follow the landing is a product decision that touches several callers.

### Outside the area
None.

## Close-out — LIN-4458

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2435 as `0dbf2d4eac531e6f8f85b6a129ba160ebec63110` (merge commit), pinned to head `75dc6235d6ac702df20ce19301c518de4dab6765` with `--match-head-commit`. Set Done after the deploy landed (the live footer at harbour.cat moved from `5cf4f6a` to `0dbf2d4`).

**How it meets what was asked:** the review's account stands (comment 50135ba2): one classifier (`COMMENT_KINDS`/`commentKindOf`) and one trail pass (`readTrail`) in `lib/run-trail.js`; the box, the stop-at guard, the owner's Done check, the merge recorder, the blind-read write check and the prompt all take their PRs from the one landing, with statuses keyed by URL. The blind read (cba19fd2) said "better".

**Changes I made after the approval (nobody re-reads them), all in `75dc6235d`:**
1. Review ledger 1 (inside): `tests/unit/lin-4458-landing-consumers.test.js` pins the empty-landing trail (impl cites A; review cites A; not-ready close-out cites A; re-review names the PR only as `#41`). It asserts `readTrail().landing` is `[]` and the box reads `no-pr` given a merged status, with the old answer (`merged`) in the test name; a companion case shows a full-URL re-review keeps the landing. The row is added to the PR body's behaviour table.
2. Review ledger 2 (inside): `findings()` in `tests/unit/lin-4458-comment-kind-census.test.js` now flags `startsWith`/`includes`/`indexOf`/`match`/`test`/`endsWith` with `BLIND_READ_HEADING`, a `SURVEY_HEADINGS` member, or a heading literal spelling an opening, with self-tests for the three forms. Mutation check: `String(1).startsWith("## Blind read")` appended to `routes/dashboard.js` turned the census red (1 fail, naming it); reverted. Zero hits in the real tree.
3. Blind read, fix-sized (inside): `docs/architecture/source-map.md` (the `close-out-readiness.js`, `blind-read-words.js` and `survey-words.js` rows corrected, and a `lib/run-trail.js` row added) and `docs/prompt-pipeline/stage-descriptions/review-closeout.md` (the review-title, verdict-word and `### Plan Review Verdict` rows now name the `COMMENT_KINDS` rows, with the stale line numbers dropped).
4. Outside finds written as Waiting entries in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`: the empty-landing root, and `lib/ci-wake-sweep.js` `prRefsFromPark`'s separate `FULL_PR_URL_RE`. Neither breaks behaviour today (no live trail has the empty-landing shape; the sweep's parser is unchanged), so by the consequence test neither is a ticket.
5. **Not done, with the reason:** the blind read's fix-sized find that `buildRunEvidence` should take its status keyed by URL with the landing already read. It is a signature change for about 25 call sites (`tests/unit/run-evidence.test.js` and `routes/dashboard.js`), so I judged it larger than a fix. It is a Waiting entry together with the blind read's larger find (the run page and the CI-wake sweep still follow every cited PR, a product decision).

**Ledger:** 1 and 2 settled by changes 1 and 2 above, with the tests run. 4 and 5 were discharged by review. 3 (URL-keyed reads against real GitHub on the live box): see below.

**CI:** green on the exact merged head `75dc6235d` (run 43478654934): Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1 to 4, Secret scan, CI success. Locally before the push: 414 tests across the area, docs and LIN-4458/4438 suites and 889 across the tests that cite the edited docs, all passing.

**Post-deploy (ledger 3):**
- Run on what landed: on the merged code, `readTrail` over the live comments gives LIN-4454 landing `[#2425]` (a single PR, so the box reads it) and LIN-4439 landing `[#2413, #2415]` (multi-PR, so the box reads none and shows not known merged). `gh` shows #2425, #2413 and #2415 all MERGED.
- **Not run:** the live task-page box for LIN-4454 and LIN-4439, and the next stop-at-PR check's log line (`[close-out-readiness] PR unreadable, admitting` must not appear for a readable PR). Why: the box is behind the workspace owner's signed-in session (`/workspace/:urlKey/api/run-evidence/...`) and the production logs are not reachable from this session. Who can run them: the workspace owner, by opening both task pages and searching the Railway logs after the next stop-at-PR check. Listed for the operator; the merge and Done do not wait on it.

**For LIN-4460:** rebase onto this change. `deriveCloseOutState` and `closeOutSetsDone` take statuses as a `Map` keyed by PR URL (an array throws) and `closeOutSetsDone` takes `prUrl`.

**Gate tickets filed:** none (both outside finds fail the consequence test; they are Waiting entries). **Related tickets:** none settled by this work, so none closed. LIN-4460 stays Todo.

## Autopilot run summary: LIN-4458 (stepper)

**Outcome:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2435 merged as 0dbf2d4eac531e6f8f85b6a129ba160ebec63110 (merged head 75dc6235d6ac702df20ce19301c518de4dab6765), deployed, ticket Done. I checked the merge, the merge commit and CI on both the merged head and the merge commit on main with gh; all 8 checks pass on each (Unit tests, Unit tests proxy clock +400d, E2E shards 1 to 4, Secret scan, CI success).

**Steps and beats run**
- Look-first: survey-task (comment ef481870), survey-place (a7c7b424), scoping (size record: consolidate the decision this task touches, no cuts, decided by the standing policy). Each read back on the ticket.
- Implementation, one warm session, 5 beats plus two follow-ups: (1) ground, A14 renewal, characterization tests first (f9a8cbcd1); (2) lib/run-trail.js, the one classifier and readTrail (93b61cc96); (2 corrective) I challenged a plan-comment predicate left outside the home and three unpinned reading changes, fixed in ad2ee9301; (3) one landing for the box, guard, owner Done check and merge recorder, statuses keyed by URL (7af68fa6b); (4) area notes, recount, reconciliation grep; (5) push, PR, CI, Linear comments, then a rebase after main moved twice (PR was CONFLICTING; re-greened on 3081a1bc7 before review).
- Review (fresh session): conditional Approve (50135ba2). Blind read: better (cba19fd2). Close-out: fixed both inside ledger items and the blind read fix-sized finds in 75dc6235d, wrote the outside finds as Waiting entries, merged pinned to that head, set Done after the deploy landed (summary 26ad6f62).

**A14:** LIN-4448 had already agreed the classifier lives in Runs (08c9c898 on LIN-4447), so the plan fallback was not used. I renewed the ask (1a2e7cba) and said which home was used on LIN-4447 (44101230); departures from the approved plan are on LIN-4447 (4e4c23c6).

**My own misstep, for the record:** after the conditional Approve the recommender chose another review. I overrode to close-out, but the blind read had not run, so close-out held without changing anything (hold comment ed641bd8). I then pinned blind-read, and resumed close-out after it posted. Cost: one hold pass; nothing merged or changed early.

**What holds:** one classifier home and one trail pass; the box, guard, owner check, merge recorder, write check and prompt read the one landing; census extended to string-method checks (mutation-checked); empty-landing case pinned. Settled Waiting entries removed, Lessons 5,866 bytes of 6,144.

**What is left (not mine to close)**
- Post-deploy check not run: the live task-page box for LIN-4454 (should read merged) and LIN-4439 (multi-PR landing, no status read), and that the line [close-out-readiness] PR unreadable, admitting does not appear for a readable PR on the next stop-at-PR check. Needs the workspace owner signed-in session and production logs; recorded as not run on the ticket and the PR.
- LIN-4460 (piece 1) must rebase onto the URL-keyed Map contract; passing an array now throws.
- Waiting entries recorded for follow-up: the empty-landing root, ci-wake-sweep second URL parser, buildRunEvidence taking URL-keyed status (about 25 call sites), and the run page and CI-wake sweep still following every cited PR (a product call).

## As asked

**Parent:** LIN-4447 (Runs & dispatch, left simpler). The parent's scope is its `## As asked` block. Its approved design and plan are the `## Design` and `## Implementation Plan` sections of the parent description, and the Design comment (6efb91fa) holds the full analysis. **Start from the parent's approved plan and follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4447.**
**Repository:** JKershaw/LinearViewer. **Grounding commit:** `origin/main` 4b5001ddf. On 2026-11-13 at 14:00Z it was still HEAD, with nothing landed since the ticket was filed.

## Piece 2 (larger): one trail pass

**Before starting:** ask LIN-4448 (A14) again whether the classifier's home is Runs. **One classifier ships either way.** If A14 declines, `commentKindOf` stays on the prompts side and Runs imports it, but there are never two.

**Approach:**

* `lib/run-trail.js` holds the one classifier `commentKindOf` and `readTrail(comments)`. `readGateTrail` and `assembleTrailFacts` both consume them.
* **Landing** = the PRs first cited after the anchor. An audit that re-cites a merged landing PR no longer joins the notes PR's landing (row 14 of `lin-4438-blind-read-gate.test.js` flips on purpose).
* **Work after review** = any later comment that cites a PR the reviewed landing did not hold, agent notes included. This fixes Seams §3.0a by failing toward review. It also counts today's non-agent landing evidence. Re-citing the reviewed PR does not restart review.
* Parse full PR URLs only through `prOf`/`prUrlsIn`.
* The box counts the landing. Its one PR read targets the landing's sole PR and is matched by URL, not by index. A multi-PR landing reads none, so it reads as not known merged.
* `resolveRunPrRef` keeps choosing from the cited URLs, because it picks a PR to show checks for.
* `extractPrUrls` stays only to record citations. `landingPrUrls` stays as a thin named export for `scripts/stability-measures-blind.mjs` and the blind-read write check.
* `readTrail` also returns the fields piece 1 reads, so that pieces 1 and 2 don't depend on each other's internals: `review`, `landing`, `closeOutAfterReview`, `workAfterReview`, `closeOutOnTrail` and `landingHasNotesPr`.
* Update the consumers of the landing rule: the blind-read write check (`routes/proxy-writes.js:723`), the blind-read prompt (`lib/prompt-template-defs.js:1293`), `lib/recommendation-look-first.js:154` and `lib/openrouter.js:982`.

**Retires:** the classifier split across `run-ledger.js` and `recommendation-facts.js`, `isLandingEvidence`, the private notes-PR set in `auditAfterLandingCloseOut`, `landingPrUrls`'s own loop, and the box's PR list as a decider. **Settles Waiting:** 16, and 15. Row 15 (a foreign PR cited before the first review) stays as a stated limit, because no caller holds the task's repository; rewrite its entry to say why.

**Testing / witness:**

* An agent note after review that cites a new PR makes `workAfterReview` true. One that re-cites the reviewed PR leaves it false.
* Row 14 flipped.
* A classifier census: no comment-kind predicate outside `lib/run-trail.js`.
* A landing of \[A\] cited beside B reads A in the box and withholds in the picker.
* Tests on the new rule for the write check and the prompt.
* **Recount:** run `scripts/stability-measures-blind.mjs` over the same window on `main` and on the branch, and record in the PR each landing whose read status changed.
* Rerun the plan's reconciliation grep and classify every hit.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4447's approving plan-review (comment 12619798-1986-467f-b67c-8bed766a7813, rev 2)

**Binding for every piece (from the parent's Constraints):** compute readiness from the trail on read and never store it. Add no GitHub or provider reads. In the same change, remove the Waiting entries this piece settles and any stale Lesson clause in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`, and keep Lessons under 6,144 bytes. Say in the PR what this piece retires. Never recompute stored pre-cutover history, and never edit recorded prompt changelog text. The LLM & prompts side of the seam belongs to LIN-4448 (A14).

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** consolidate the decision this task touches
**Why:** Delivers the one classifier and landing reader, and has the close-out guards and the owner's Done check read that same landing, matched by pull request rather than position; otherwise the box counts the landing while they count every citation.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Implemented (stub; stage artifacts pruned at close-out)

Implemented and merged: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2435](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2435>) (merge commit `0dbf2d4eac531e6f8f85b6a129ba160ebec63110`, deployed). The parent's approved plan was followed; the departures (URL-keyed status `Map` moved in from piece 1, Done loosened for an abandoned PR outside the landing, a stricter `head-moved` on the landing, the `area-read` kind) are recorded on LIN-4447. The review, the blind read and the close-out summary are in the comments, and the full pre-prune history is in the task snapshots. Leftovers live as `## Waiting` entries in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`; one post-deploy check (the live box on LIN-4454 and LIN-4439) is recorded as not run in the close-out comment.
